state_before:
p : Prop
h : p ∨ p
⊢ p
tactic: cases h with | inl hp => exact hp | inr hp => exact hp

theorem_statement: (p q r : Prop) (h : p ∨ q) (f : p → r) (g : q → r) : r
state_before:
p q r : Prop
h : p ∨ q
f : p → r
g : q → r
⊢ r
tactic: cases h with | inl hp => exact f hp | inr hq => exact g hq

theorem_statement: (a b : Prop) (h : a ∨ b) : b ∨ a
state_before:
a b : Prop
h : a ∨ b
⊢ b ∨ a
tactic: cases h with | inl ha => exact Or.inr ha | inr hb => exact Or.inl hb

state_before:
p : Prop
h : p ∨ False
⊢ p
tactic: cases h with | inl hp => exact hp | inr hf => exact hf.elim

state_before:
p : Prop
h : True ∨ p
⊢ True
tactic: cases h with | inl ht => exact ht | inr _ => trivial
